name: Alex Kim
title: Junior Engineer
description: A junior engineer who sees normal engineering and general content. Has access to most non-secret items but cannot view security incident channels or business/financial reports.

name: Jordan Lee
title: Outside Contractor
description: An outside contractor who sees very little. Only has access to general/onboarding content, the random channel, and brand assets. Cannot see engineering, business, or security items.

name: David Okafor
title: Security Team Member
description: A security team member who sees everything including secret items like breach reports, incident responses, and penetration test results.

name: Lisa Bergstrom
title: Compliance Officer
description: A compliance officer who sees everything the security team sees, plus can access the audit diary. Checks the diary for tampering and ensures all access is logged.
